class.name: Saves
class.brief_description: Player 1's saves, on disk first and synced in the background.
class.description: [method save] writes to disk at once, and the save is then synced in the background with the online service, the platform's cloud (Steam Cloud, iCloud or Play Games' saved games) or nothing, as [code]saves/backend[/code] in Project Settings says ([code]automatic[/code] by default: the online service once the player has added an email, otherwise the platform's cloud). If two devices saved differently, [signal conflict] offers both and [method resolve_conflict] keeps one. A guest's saves are their [member LocalPlayer.saves]. [codeblock] Saves.save("slot1", {"level": 3}, {"level": 3}) var data = Saves.load("slot1") [/codeblock] Slot names are 1 to 64 of [code]a-z[/code], [code]0-9[/code], [code]-[/code] and [code]_[/code].

method.name: get_backend
method.description: Returns where the saves sync to.

method.name: get_slots
method.description: Returns the slots with a save on this device.

method.name: get_summary
method.description: Returns the summary saved with the save in [param slot].

method.name: has
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param slot] has a save on this device.

method.name: load
method.description: Returns the save in [param slot] on this device, or [code]null[/code] if there's none. Saves from other devices arrive as they sync ([signal synced]).

method.name: resolve_conflict
method.description: After [signal conflict]: keeps this device's save in [param slot] (uploading it over the other) if [param keep_local] is [code]true[/code], or replaces it with the other device's.

method.name: save
method.description: Saves [param data] (any [Variant] that can be serialised) in [param slot], on disk at once and then in the background to the player's cloud. [param summary] is shown if the player has to choose between two saves, for example [code]{"level": 4, "playtime": 7200}[/code].

method.name: sync
method.description: Brings this device and the cloud in line now: newer saves come down, saves not yet synced go up. It also happens by itself after signing in and after each save.

signal.name: conflict
signal.description: Emitted when another device saved differently in [param slot]. Show both summaries and call [method resolve_conflict].

signal.name: synced
signal.description: Emitted when the save in [param slot] has been synced with the player's cloud, including a newer one that came down from another device.
